text:
vik: Heads-up: side-channel kernel swap tonight 23:30 UTC. quant-kernel:5.0 -> 5.1 (matmul micro-optim). Plan: tiny-slice 4%, hold thermal-buckets 2 for 20m.

mira: who on smoke and quick evals? any driver caveats?

vik: priya will do smoke, nate infra. sam/docs get a short blurb + pin snippet. Known caveat: older nvidia-470 drivers may show mem-pressure on long-seqs; we will watch.

priya: smoke checklist: 4x short-gen, 2 chat continuity, 1 KV warmstart. Pass: p95 < baseline+22%, errors <0.5%. Script:
```bash
# smoke
curl -s -X POST https://staging-infer/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"quant-kernel:5.1","input":"smoke"}' | jq .
```
Posting results T+4m.

nate: infra thresholds: GPU temp <79C, node mem <86%, OoM=0. If node mem >86% isolate & pin.

deploybot: Deploybot: swap scheduled. pin command:
`/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:5.0 ttl=8h reason="night-safety"`
Abort: `/deploy abort <swap-id>`

priya: smoke T+4m: 4/4 short-gen pass, p95 +9%, errs 0.1%. GPU temps ~73C.

vik: OK start in 2m. tiny-slice 4%, hold bucket 2.

deploybot: swap started swap-id=sc-20240630-03

~5m post-swap~

priya: quick checks: global p95 +14%, errs 0.25%. node-nv-12 shows mem-pressure 88% and p95 spike.

nate: confirming node-nv-12 mem 88%. isolating and draining.

vik: pin node-nv-12 to 5.0 and exclude. Do not rollback globally.

deploybot: `/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:5.0 ttl=12h target=node-nv-12 reason="mem-pressure"`

ops-bot: Alert: node-nv-12 mem-pressure > threshold at 23:37 UTC. LB: draining node-nv-12.

sam: updated release note: add note about node exclusion and pin command. Pushed.

priya: T+10m eval: one prompt regressed 1.8% below rollback. KV eviction stable. No OoM.

vik: promote to 15% after T+20m if stable. leave node pinned 12h. action items: priya save smoke artifacts; nate monitor; sam finalize notes tomorrow AM.

deploybot: swap complete swap-id=sc-20240630-03 status=healthy.

mira: thanks team. I'll add node-exclusion step to post-deploy checklist. Closing thread.
